explanation: Generated an eta-channel EXCLURAD input using the repository defaults (EtaMAID model 3, full O(alpha) correction, 6.53 GeV electron beam, detected recoil proton, and vcut = 0.166 GeV^2). The requested phi* = 370 degrees was normalized modulo 360 to the physically equivalent canonical angle 10 degrees. W = 1.7 GeV is above the proton-eta threshold and, together with Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2 and cos(theta*) = 0.5, lies inside the documented eta production grid.
